summary.en: The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in San Francisco is broadening its reach in showcasing Hong Kong cinema through institutional partnerships with the University of San Francisco and the Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive, connecting Hong Kong films with university and museum communities across the San Francisco Bay Area. summary.en: Nearly a year after the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, the Mental Health Advisory Committee says its "Together We Walk" support programme has reached more than 3,300 residents who were relocated across different districts, with about 200 people referred to psychiatrists or clinical psychologists and about 1,800 people having received counselling. Outreach workers contacted 56 residents and found about one in five showed symptoms of post-traumatic stress disorder and about 15 per cent showed symptoms of depression; after psychological support, those rates fell to single digits. summary.en: Bitcoin has fallen below US$58,000 to its lowest since September 2024, dropping about 6 per cent in a day and touching an intraday low of about US$57,778. Ether fell about 7 per cent to around US$1,622, while XRP, Solana and BNB lost about 5 to 6 per cent. About US$1.5 billion in leveraged crypto positions were wiped out in 24 hours, and US spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds saw US$582 million in net outflows on Thursday, including a record US$541.1 million redemption from BlackRock's IBIT fund. Bitcoin is down about 25 per cent in November, on track for its worst month since June 2022 and a seventh straight weekly loss, and has fallen more than 50 per cent from its record above US$126,000 set in October 2025.
